entities.summary: Johnathan "Rudy" Ford is an American professional football safety. He played college football at Auburn, and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the sixth round of the 2017 NFL draft. He has also played for the Philadelphia Eagles, Jacksonville Jaguars, and Green Bay Packers.
